A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc in the bottom-right corner of the card frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 7 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-lukeseeker-PC-Errata-2016-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Luke Seeker (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text is reworded: “Use 1 Force to deploy on opponent's side at any unoccupied site. Moves during your control phase, like a character, at normal use of the Force. When at same location as Luke of ability &lt; 4 or pilot of ability &lt;3, choose one to be immediately lost. Seeker also lost.” This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits in the bottom-right corner of the card frame.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
